name: Derived non-derived exclusion from derived filters
expected: A standard line (PBE.IsDerived=false -> ItemIsDerived__std=false/null) is EXCLUDED from Derived Pricing Filter [40], Derived Maintenance Net Filter [39] and the Derived Pricing Formula branch (all gated ItemIsDerived__std Equals true), and is INCLUDED by Stamp Base Filter [107] ((ItemIsDerived__std IsNull OR =false) AND QuoteTypeText__c!='Renewal' AND ItemPricingSource!='LastTransaction' AND NetUnitPrice>0) so the standard waterfall applies: NetUnitPrice=ListPrice, Base_Price__c/Pre_Partner_Price__c stamped from net, Source_List_Price__c (derived stamp) stays null.
actual: Static trace of LIVE V21 metadata confirmed the three derived gates are exactly ItemIsDerived__std Equals true and Stamp Base Filter is (IsNull OR =false) AND QuoteTypeText__c!='Renewal' AND ItemPricingSource!='LastTransaction' AND NetUnitPrice>0. Live Force-reprice of a real new-business standard non-derived Subscription line (BP-ETM-RMS-ADDITH, PBE 01uWC000005wrrIYAQ IsDerived=false, Fortra Price Book active, list 10000 USD, QuoteTypeText__c='New') through Active V21: isSuccess:true, errorResponse:[]; result NetUnitPrice=ListPrice=Base_Price__c=Pre_Partner_Price__c=10000, Source_List_Price__c=null -> standard waterfall ran (Stamp Base branch), derived branches skipped. Inverse control: real derived maintenance lines (PIA-PIA-RNM-PIAMBK, ItemIsDerived=true) carry Source_List_Price__c=355 and Base_Price__c=null (derived branch ran, standard skipped) -> the field split is the genuine discriminator. Eleven additional real non-derived Subscription/Perpetual new-quote lines (5250 Integrator 2021.25, Cobalt Strike Subscription 5900, etc.) show the same pattern (Base_Price__c populated, Source_List_Price__c null on pure non-contributors).
evidence: Active proc V21 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY (VersionNumber 21, Active). Reprice POST /services/data/v64.0/connect/rev/sales-transaction/actions/place -> isSuccess:true (Data/pricing-v21-validation/a05/reprice_resp.json). Control line https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/QuoteLineItem/0QLWC000003kdnp4AA/view (BP-ETM-RMS-ADDITH, net=list=base=prePartner=10000, srcList=null) on quote https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FTJJ0A4/view (QuoteTypeText__c='New'). Metadata gating dump Data/pricing-v21-validation/a05/v21_meta_only.json: Derived Pricing Filter[40] & Derived Maintenance Net Filter[39] criteria = {ItemIsDerived__std Equals true}; Stamp Base Filter[107] (parentStep=StampContributorBasePreDiscount) = (1 OR 2) AND 3 AND 4 AND 5 over [ItemIsDerived__std IsNull | =false; QuoteTypeText__c!='Renewal'; ItemPricingSource!='LastTransaction'; NetUnitPrice>0]. Inverse derived control QLI 0QLWC000003kiyo4AA (srcList=355, base=null).
notes: Config/parity-style scenario validated per brief (existing real records + proc metadata + one live Force-reprice), no DML fixture. The gate field ItemIsDerived__std is sourced from PricebookEntry.IsDerived; all standard software/subscription/perpetual PBEs confirmed IsDerived=false. Quantity (test_setup says Qty=3) is immaterial to the routing claim - the gate is ItemIsDerived__std, not quantity; TotalPrice scales as NetUnitPrice*Qty regardless. Avoided the A-01/A-02 headless base-seed gap by using a UI-priced existing line rather than an Apex-inserted fresh line; the live Force-reprice preserved the correct net. Caveat documented (not a defect): 55 non-derived NRPS *contributor* license lines carry a non-null Source_List_Price__c, but that is stamped by the before-pricing flow Stamp_Source_List_Price (so the maintenance line can read it), NOT by the V21 derived procedure branches - those contributor lines still took the standard waterfall (Base_Price__c populated, net=list). The pure non-contributor control (BP-ETM-RMS-ADDITH) has Source_List_Price__c=null, the cleanest match to test_setup. defect_provenance='none / catalog-derived' (baseline, expected exclusion) - no defect; related derived-pricing tickets SC-3372/SC-3346/J-09 concern the INVERSE (derived lines that fail), not non-derived exclusion, which is correct.
verdict_reason: Live V21 metadata shows the three derived gates require ItemIsDerived__std==true and Stamp Base Filter includes (IsNull OR =false); a real IsDerived=false new-quote line Force-repriced through V21 to net=list=base=10000 with Source_List_Price__c null, so the standard waterfall applied and the derived branches were skipped exactly as expected.
